section: Basic features of the Andhra Pradesh economy after bifurcation - GSDP, growth rate, sectoral shares
subsections: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors

accepted.s: According to the 2022-23 NSO Second Advance Estimates, which sector had the highest share in Andhra Pradesh GVA at current prices?
accepted.x: In 2022-23, services accounted for 40.45% of Andhra Pradesh GVA, exceeding agriculture and allied at 36.19% and industry at 23.36%.
accepted.tq: Identify the largest percentage directly from the sectoral table.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the sectoral shares in Andhra Pradesh GVA at current prices:
1. In 2022-23, agriculture and allied accounted for 36.19 per cent.
2. In 2024-25, services accounted for 41.53 per cent.
3. In 2025-26, industry accounted for 24 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly reproduce the sectoral shares: 36.19% for agriculture and allied in 2022-23, 41.53% for services in 2024-25 and 24% for industry in 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical statement against the corresponding year before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following broad sectors of Andhra Pradesh GVA in descending order of their shares in 2025-26 at current prices:
A. Industry
B. Services
C. Agriculture and allied
accepted.x: In 2025-26, services had a 43% share, agriculture and allied 33%, and industry 24%. Therefore, the descending order is Services, Agriculture and allied, Industry.
accepted.tq: Order the items by comparing the numerical values rather than by their usual economic sequence.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the distinctive sectoral feature of the Andhra Pradesh economy?
o: Agriculture and allied activities account for exactly half of GVA in every year.
Services is the largest sector, while agriculture's share is about one-third and is well above the national share of about 18 per cent.
The share of services remains below the national agricultural share.
Industry is the largest sector and agriculture has a negligible share.
accepted.x: Services is the largest broad sector in Andhra Pradesh, but agriculture's share is around one-third, substantially higher than the national share of about 18% of GVA.
accepted.tq: Use the relative comparison between Andhra Pradesh and the national structure to eliminate reversed statements.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following is the correct descending order of selected sub-sector shares in Andhra Pradesh GVA in 2025-26 at current prices?
1. Manufacturing
2. Fishing and aquaculture
3. Other services
4. Real estate
accepted.x: The shares were manufacturing 10.84%, fishing and aquaculture 9.42%, other services 8.81% and real estate 8.51%, giving the stated order.
accepted.tq: Arrange close percentage values from highest to lowest and avoid reversing neighbouring entries.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Within agriculture and allied activities of Andhra Pradesh, which sub-sector had the largest GVA at constant prices in 2025-26 FAE?
accepted.x: Fishing and aquaculture had the largest constant-price GVA at ₹90,673 crore, followed by horticulture, livestock, crops and forestry.
accepted.tq: Locate the maximum value in the constant-price agriculture and allied series.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about agriculture and allied GVA in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26 FAE at constant prices:
1. Horticulture ranked second among the listed sub-sectors.
2. Livestock ranked below horticulture but above agriculture comprising crops.
3. Forestry and logging had a GVA of ₹2,737 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Horticulture was second at ₹65,879 crore, livestock third at ₹65,486 crore, crops fourth at ₹27,999 crore, and forestry and logging stood at ₹2,737 crore.
accepted.tq: Verify both the ranking and the exact value before choosing the coded answer.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In 2024-25, horticulture GVA of Andhra Pradesh at current prices was ₹1,52,950 crore. What was its reported growth rate?
accepted.x: Horticulture GVA was ₹1,52,950 crore in 2024-25 at current prices and grew by 21%.
accepted.tq: Separate the current-price horticulture figure and growth rate from the constant-price sub-sector table.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What share of Andhra Pradesh's horticulture GVA in 2024-25 was contributed by Rayalaseema?
accepted.x: Rayalaseema contributed ₹76,458 crore out of the horticulture GVA of ₹1,52,950 crore in 2024-25.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the regional contribution from statewide sub-sector totals.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The estimates of Andhra Pradesh GVA referred to in the sectoral series were compiled by which agency?
o: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: The series was compiled by the Directorate of Economics and Statistics of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the agency responsible for compiling the state statistical series.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the price basis and base year of the Andhra Pradesh State Estimates of GVA is correct?
o: SES 2024-25 and SES 2025-26 use 2011-12 as the base year for constant prices.
The estimates are prepared only at current prices.
The estimates use 2022-23 as the base year for all state series.
Both estimates use 2019-20 as the official base year.
accepted.x: SES 2024-25 and SES 2025-26 use the 2011-12 base for constant-price estimates. The reference to a 2019-20 base is identified as erroneous.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between current prices, constant prices and competing base-year claims.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: State Domestic Product (SDP) is best defined as:
o: The value of all final goods exported by residents of a State during a year
The value of agricultural output alone produced within a State
The total tax revenue collected by a State in a financial year
The value of all goods and services produced within the State's boundaries in a year, counted without duplication
accepted.x: SDP measures the value of goods and services produced within the geographical boundaries of the State during a year without double counting.
accepted.tq: Apply the definition by checking both the territorial boundary and the exclusion of duplication.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: How many broad sectors and sub-sectors are identified in the Andhra Pradesh GVA classification?
accepted.x: The classification contains three broad sectors—agriculture, industry and services—and 17 sub-sectors in total.
accepted.tq: Recall the paired count rather than treating the broad sectors and sub-sectors separately.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT included under the agriculture and allied sector classification of Andhra Pradesh GVA?
accepted.x: Agriculture and allied activities include agriculture, horticulture, livestock, forestry and logging, and fishing and aquaculture. Construction belongs to the industry sector.
accepted.tq: Find the item belonging to the neighbouring industry group rather than agriculture and allied.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the industry sector of Andhra Pradesh GVA?
o: Mining, manufacturing, electricity-gas-water supply and construction
Banking, insurance, real estate and public administration
accepted.x: The four industry sub-sectors are mining, manufacturing, electricity-gas-water supply, and construction.
accepted.tq: Classify the sub-sectors by sector and eliminate lists made from agriculture or services.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the services sector classification in Andhra Pradesh GVA:
1. Banking and insurance are included in services.
2. Public administration is included in services.
3. Mining is included in services.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Banking and insurance and public administration are services sub-sectors. Mining belongs to industry, so statement 3 is incorrect.
accepted.tq: Use sector classification to identify the single wrongly placed sub-sector.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which sub-sector had the largest GVA at constant prices in the agriculture and allied sector in both the 2024-25 FAE and 2025-26 FAE series?
accepted.x: Fishing and aquaculture led the agriculture and allied constant-price series in 2024-25 at ₹77,085 crore and again in 2025-26 at ₹90,673 crore.
accepted.tq: Compare the leading item across two years instead of relying on the current-price ranking.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which sub-sector recorded the fastest growth in the agriculture and allied sector in Andhra Pradesh in 2024-25 FAE at constant prices?
accepted.x: Agriculture comprising crops recorded 14.99% growth, the highest among the listed agriculture and allied sub-sectors in 2024-25.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the fastest-growing sub-sector from the largest sub-sector.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which sub-sector recorded the slowest growth in the agriculture and allied sector in Andhra Pradesh in 2024-25 FAE at constant prices?
accepted.x: Forestry and logging recorded the slowest growth at 0.04% in 2024-25 FAE at constant prices.
accepted.tq: Look for the minimum growth rate rather than the maximum GVA value.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: At current prices in 2024-25, which sub-sector had the largest GVA among all sub-sectors of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Livestock had the largest GVA among all sub-sectors at current prices in 2024-25, with a share of about 12%.
accepted.tq: Apply the price-basis distinction: current-price leadership differs from constant-price leadership.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the current-price shares of selected agriculture and allied sub-sectors in Andhra Pradesh GVA in 2024-25?
accepted.x: The reported current-price shares were livestock 12%, horticulture 10%, crops 4% and forestry 1%.
accepted.tq: Match each sub-sector with its percentage and watch for swapped values.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which sub-sector was the largest contributor to the services GVA of Andhra Pradesh in 2024-25 FAE at constant prices?
accepted.x: Trade, hotels and restaurants had the largest services GVA at ₹69,836 crore in 2024-25 FAE at constant prices.
accepted.tq: Identify the maximum value within the services sub-sector table.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding services sub-sector growth in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Banking and insurance grew by 14.25 per cent in 2024-25.
2. Public administration recorded the lowest growth in 2024-25 at 0.09 per cent.
3. Communications was the top-performing services sub-sector in 2025-26 at 15.13 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: banking and insurance grew 14.25%, public administration recorded 0.09% in 2024-25, and communications led in 2025-26 with 15.13%.
accepted.tq: Check each year separately because the leading and lowest sub-sectors change across years.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What was the GVA of the services sector of Andhra Pradesh in 2024-25 FAE at constant prices, and what was its growth rate?
accepted.x: Services GVA was ₹3,28,713 crore in 2024-25 FAE at constant prices, growing by 8.53%.
accepted.tq: Pair the sector total with its corresponding growth rate, not with a sub-sector figure.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the growth rates of trade, hotels and restaurants in 2024-25 and 2025-26 FAE respectively?
accepted.x: Trade, hotels and restaurants grew by 9.02% in 2024-25 and 12.41% in 2025-26 FAE.
accepted.tq: Preserve the year-wise order and avoid interchanging the two annual growth figures.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
1. Real estate and dwellings — 6.43% growth in 2024-25
2. Transport and storage — 12.47% growth in 2024-25
3. Banking and insurance — 13.59% growth in 2025-26 FAE
4. Railways — 15.13% growth in 2025-26 FAE
accepted.x: Railways grew by 5.90% in 2025-26, while communications recorded 15.13%. The first three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the single swapped sub-sector and growth rate in a mostly correct list.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the revised national series, which base year was adopted and what were the revised growth rates for 2023-24 and 2024-25?
accepted.x: The national series moved to the 2022-23 base. It revised 2023-24 growth to 7.2% and 2024-25 growth to 7.1%.
accepted.tq: Match the new base year with both revised annual growth rates.
accepted.sec: Sectoral shares in AP GVA - broad sectors and largest sub-sectors  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What was the approximate effect of the revised national series on the absolute size of GDP?
o: It shrank by about 3–4 per cent.
It declined by exactly 18 per cent.
It increased by about 10–12 per cent.
accepted.x: The revised national series reduced the reported absolute size of GDP by approximately 3–4%.
accepted.tq: Choose the reported approximate range and reject exact or reversed claims.
